name: web-forager
description: Live web discovery tool. Formulates search queries, fetches results via DuckDuckGo lite, evaluates relevance, creates knowledge notes, and updates the graph. Falls back to search-plan mode if network is unavailable.

inputs.name: mode
inputs.description: 'discover' to search and store, 'search-plan' to output queries for assistant, 'ingest' to store pre-fetched results

inputs.name: results
inputs.description: Pre-fetched results for mode=ingest: [{title, url, snippet}]

outputs.name: result
outputs.description: Findings with knowledge note path, graph node ID, and top results
